# Psalm 147 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Praise Yah! For good to-sing-praises to-our-God, for pleasant — fitting praise.

**2** Builder-of Jerusalem YHWH; the-outcasts-of Israel he-gathers.

**3** The-healer of-the-broken-of heart, and-binder of-their-wounds.

**4** Counter of-number to-the-stars; to-all-of-them names he-calls.

**5** Great our-Lord and-abundant-in-power; to-his-understanding there-is-no number.

**6** Lifter-of the-humble YHWH; bringing-low the-wicked to-the-ground.

**7** Sing to-YHWH with-thanksgiving; sing-praises to-our-God with-the-lyre.

**8** The-one-covering the-heavens with-clouds, the-one-preparing for-the-earth rain, the-one-causing-to-sprout on-mountains grass.

**9** Giving to-the-beast its-food, to-young-of ravens which cry.

**10** Not in-strength-of the-horse he-delights, not in-legs-of the-man he-takes-pleasure.

**11** Takes-pleasure YHWH in-those-fearing-him, in-those-hoping in-his-steadfast-love.

**12** Praise O-Jerusalem YHWH; praise your-God O-Zion.

**13** For he-has-strengthened the-bars-of your-gates; he-has-blessed your-children within-you.

**14** The-one-setting your-border peace; with-finest-of wheat he-satisfies-you.

**15** The-one-sending his-command to-the-earth; quickly runs his-word.

**16** The-one-giving snow like-wool; frost like-ashes he-scatters.

**17** Casting his-ice like-morsels; before his-cold who can-stand?

**18** He-sends his-word and-melts-them; he-causes-to-blow his-wind, flow the-waters.

**19** Declaring his-words to-Jacob, his-statutes and-his-judgments to-Israel.

**20** Not he-has-done so to-any nation, and-judgments not they-have-known-them. Praise Yah!

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **147:3-4**: Juxtaposition: 'healer of-the-broken-of heart' / 'counter of-number to-the-stars' — the God who numbers galaxies also binds personal wounds. Infinite scope meets intimate care.

- **147:15-18**: God's word governs weather — snow, frost, ice, thaw. The same word that commands creation also speaks Torah to Israel (vv. 19-20).

— EMET
